Primary Short Report with all three pages, methods, results, figure and references, not an abstract or secondary report. No PDF supplied. Results are on printed page 2 despite supplied p.1 locator. Only assigned original effect and p fields are completed; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. Results explicitly identify Duchenne smiles compared with nonsmilers and print HR = 0.50 with p = .006 for the same contrast. Retain the printed hazard-ratio metric without conversion despite the requested test-statistic type; omnibus chi-squares are separate tests. Procedure and Figure 1 caption explicitly equate full and Duchenne smiles. No separate contrast-specific Wald/z statistic is given.
